reasoning: The question asks whether US tariffs went up in 2025 iff Trump wins (resolving YES if Trump wins AND tariffs go up, or if Trump loses AND tariffs don't go up). Evidence confirms: (1) Trump won the 2024 election and took office in January 2025; (2) Tariffs dramatically increased in 2025—effective tariff rates reached nearly 17% by November 2025, seven times higher than January, the highest since 1935. Trump implemented reciprocal tariffs starting April 2025, with rates ranging 10-50% on hundreds of countries. The Supreme Court struck down most tariffs in February 2026, but this occurred after 2025. Therefore, the condition is satisfied: Trump won AND tariffs went up in 2025.
